profile.headline: Staff  Software Engineer at Aetna, a CVS Health Company
profile.summary:
Staff Software Engineer with 15+ years of experience designing, building, and scaling high-performance mobile applications, specializing in Android development with additional expertise in iOS and back-end systems. Proven ability to lead the technical direction of complex, business-critical initiatives, drive architectural decisions, and deliver reliable, scalable solutions used by millions of users.

Experienced in leading cross-functional teams, mentoring engineers, and partnering with product, design, and business stakeholders to align technical strategy with organizational goals. Strong background in modern software architecture, cloud services, DevOps, CI/CD, production operations, and performance optimization for high-traffic applications.

Passionate about solving complex technical challenges, improving engineering excellence, and fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement while delivering measurable business impact.
